description: A shell script used for flashing bootloader images and other firmware components onto a device, specifically tailored for the 'stingray' device model. The script includes functions to flash the bootloader and handle other partition flashes, with logging and validation steps.

methods.name: flash_bootloader_image
methods.description: Flashes the bootloader image onto the device after validating device type and bootloader file existence.

methods.name: flash_userdata_image
methods.description: Intended to flash userdata image; currently not supported and skips update.

methods.name: flash_radio_image
methods.description: Intended to flash radio partition; currently not supported and skips update.
